## Checklist

- [ ] The new or changed tests fail without this change and pass with it.
- [ ] If a guard changed, its JS and Python twins (where both exist) behave the same and tests cover both.
- [ ] `tools/` still uses only Node.js built-ins / the Python standard library.
- [ ] Docs (README.md, README.es.md, AGENTS.md) and CHANGELOG.md are updated where relevant.
- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`fix(scope): ...`, `feat(scope): ...`).
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or private data in code, tests, fixtures or logs.
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally.
